component_ablations.change: Set funding penalty to zero; keep the lagged state, state-specific trend, construction, no-control policy, and base costs identical.
component_ablations.causal_claim_tested: Actual funding de-crowding reduces funding drag and squeeze exposure in the pivot rather than merely perturbing ranks.
component_ablations.decision: Retain the funding term only if it reduces net funding drag without breaking the reference causal, regime, role, or doubled-cost gates.
component_ablations.prerequisite: rctc-pivot-ref-001 passes every no-control pivot falsifier gate

component_ablations.change: Set direction tilt delta to zero so each sleeve remains at gross 0.40; keep regime routing and rankings identical.
component_ablations.causal_claim_tested: The same lagged BTC direction value improves long-bull and short-bear roles without sacrificing chop.
component_ablations.decision: Retain the tilt only if all common gates pass and declared J is higher than this zero-tilt cell.
component_ablations.prerequisite: rctc-pivot-ref-001 passes every no-control pivot falsifier gate

component_ablations.change: Use path-efficient raw asset trend in bull, bear, and chop; keep lagged state labels for attribution and keep every other term identical.
component_ablations.causal_claim_tested: Residualization remains useful specifically in bull and chop, while raw common downside information is needed specifically in bear.
component_ablations.decision: If all-raw dominates the reference on J and all required roles, the conditional residualization thesis is unsupported and requires formal review rather than silent adoption.
component_ablations.prerequisite: rctc-pivot-ref-001 passes every no-control pivot falsifier gate

component_ablations.change: Invert only the sign used for branch routing: route the observed bull state to raw trend and observed bear to residual trend; leave observed regime attribution, direction tilt, funding, and construction unchanged.
component_ablations.causal_claim_tested: The economic mapping of raw trend to bear, rather than a generic state switch, carries the improvement.
component_ablations.decision: The placebo should have lower bear return, short-bear attribution, and J. Contrary evidence rejects the claimed state mapping.
component_ablations.prerequisite: rctc-pivot-ref-001 passes every no-control pivot falsifier gate

historical_comparator.reuse_rule: Use only its already completed canonical evidence as the all-residual comparator; do not rerun, modify, or charge it as a pivot cell.

metrics_required_for_every_new_cell: long and short sleeve exposure, activity, and notional
six chronological fold returns and Sharpes
risk action counts and time under every scale for risk cells

risk_decision_rule.admissibility: Register risk cells only after the no-control reference clears every pivot causal, fold, regime, and role gate.
risk_decision_rule.combined_policy_minimum_effect: Versus no control at the same costs, maximum drawdown and 1% daily expected shortfall must both improve; expected shortfall must improve at least 10%; annualized return retention must be at least 70%; neither base- nor doubled-cost Sharpe may fall more than 0.05; every mandatory regime and role gate must remain satisfied.
risk_decision_rule.fallback: If combined fails, choose the least complex admissible individual control, otherwise no control. Tie-break by lower maximum drawdown, lower turnover, then canonical policy ID.
risk_decision_rule.non_rescue: No risk cell may be registered or used to rescue a reference that fails its pivot falsifier.

trial_accounting.rule: Every new material cell is registered before execution; no planned cell is authorized merely by appearing here.
